info.title: open4x REST API
info.description:
REST surface for the open4x single-player Civ-VI-style 4X. Every endpoint round-trips JSON; mutations return a `MutationResponse<T>` envelope with the freshly-projected slice and a turn-status block so the client can refresh the HUD bar without a second request.

**Auth.** Bootstrap via `POST /api/v1/games/new` to mint a bearer token. Every other endpoint (besides `/health`) requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Source of truth.** This document is generated from the Rust source by `cargo run -p open4x-server --features openapi --bin gen-openapi`. Do not hand-edit `book/src/multiplayer/openapi.json`.

**Multiplayer.** The WebSocket surface at `/ws` (Ed25519-authenticated; `ClientMessage` / `ServerMessage` JSON frames) is **not** described here. See `book/src/multiplayer/protocol.md` and `open4x-protocol::v1::messages` for those types.

200.description: Liveness probe. Unauthenticated.

201.description: New single-player game created. Returned token authenticates every subsequent /api/v1 call.

200.description: Resource bar + global player state for the authenticated civ.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Camera centre column (axial q). Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Camera centre row (axial r). Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Cube-distance radius around (q, r). 0 = all explored. Hard-capped at 32.

200.description: Sparse fog-of-war-filtered tile list around the camera.
Single tile detail.
Catalogue of toggleable map overlays. Toggle state is client-side.
All known cities. Own cities include full production detail; foreign cities are limited.
Territory + worked-tile flags for the city hex view.
Item appended to the production queue. Returns the updated city row.
Item removed. Returns the updated city row.
Focus updated. Returns the city row.
City renamed (1..=64 chars after trim).
Action applied. View payload is the updated unit (or null for no-op).

202.description: Stubbed action (fortify/sleep). View payload is null.

200.description: Army/corps formations (stub; empty until libciv ships the system).
Heuristic combat preview. `note` flags the libciv-driven replacement.
Queued research target.
Active research dropped (idempotent — no-op on empty queue). Partial progress is discarded.
Queued civic target.
Active civic dropped (idempotent). Partial progress discarded.
Government switched. Active policies that no longer fit the slot config are unslotted.

204.description: All notifications for the authenticated civ dismissed.

200.description: Required and skippable pending actions for the current turn.
Turn advanced. View payload is `{ turn }`.

400.description: Required turn-queue items unresolved. Body shape: `{ error: "unresolved_required_actions", items: [...] }`.

200.description: Unit-type and building catalogues. Stable across turns.

ApiErrorBody.description: Standard error envelope returned with non-2xx statuses.

government.description:
Government name as it appears in the wire registry (e.g. "Chiefdom",
"Monarchy", "Democracy"). Case-sensitive — matches `Government.name`.

CivId.description: CivId — Crockford-base32 ULID (26 chars). Wire form is the bare ULID string.

GameId.description: GameId — Crockford-base32 ULID (26 chars). Wire form is the bare ULID string.

name.description: New city name. Server enforces 1..=64 chars after trim.
City name when `action_id == "found_city"`. Defaults to "New City".

bearer.description: Token returned by `POST /api/v1/games/new`. Submit as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent request.
